k:番.mnemonic: Farmers stand in a line to sift (釆) seed over the rice field (田), passing the sieve along. When it reaches your hands, it is your go. Turn (number, order).
k:番.hint: The sieve passed down the line.

k:店.mnemonic: Under a canopy (广) a fortune-telling (占) booth is set up, selling futures to anyone walking past: a little street stall. Store (shop).

k:界.mnemonic: A rice field (田) balanced on a hat (𠆢), with legs (儿) below: a farmer carrying his whole field on his head. Everything inside its edges is all he knows. World (boundary, realm).

k:幾.mnemonic: Tiny (幺) silk threads become (成) a robe on the loom. The weaver squints at them and wonders what number it will take. How many (how much, how far, how long).
k:幾.hint: Counting silk threads on a loom.

k:機.mnemonic: A frame cut from a tree (木), holding who knows how many (幾) threads at once: the wooden loom, clacking away by itself. Machine (mechanism, opportunity, loom).
k:機.hint: A wooden loom full of threads.

k:予.mnemonic: The muzzle (マ) goes on the dog first, so that when the walk is complete (了) nobody has been bitten. Trouble sorted out ahead of time. Beforehand (in advance, myself, previous).

k:州.mnemonic: A river (川) with drops (丶) of land between its streams: sandbanks, each claimed by planting a stick (｜) as a border post. Every island is its own province. State (province).

k:政.mnemonic: Strike (攵) the table again and again until everyone agrees that you are correct (正): this is how rulers argue. Politics (government).
k:政.hint: Banging the table to be right.

k:特.mnemonic: A cow (牛) kept at the temple (寺): no plough for her, she is hung with garlands and fed by the monks. Not an ordinary cow at all. Special (particular, especially).

k:設.mnemonic: The commander plants a weapon (殳) in the ground and has only to say (言) the word: the camp goes here. Tents rise on the spot. Establish (set up, prepare, establishment).

k:要.mnemonic: The west (西) presses down on a woman (女): the sun is setting behind her and she must get home before dark. It is essential. Need (main point, essential, require).

k:石.mnemonic: A cliff edge, and at its foot a boulder that has rolled down and come to rest. Stone (rock).

k:広.mnemonic: A huge canopy (广) with only one little cocoon (厶) under it: so much empty room on every side. Wide (broad, spacious).
k:広.hint: One cocoon in a huge tent.

k:約.mnemonic: A thread (糸) tied round a cradle (勹) with a small knot: the parents' vow to the baby, bound tight so it cannot slip. Promise (approximately, contract, shrink).
k:約.hint: A knot tied on the cradle.

k:別.mnemonic: Nobody should add (加) a knife (刂) to a cradle (勹). Sharp things go in one room and the baby in another, kept well apart. Separate (different, another, branch off).
k:別.hint: Blades kept away from the baby.

k:始.mnemonic: A woman (女) steps up onto the pedestal (台) and raises her flag: runners, get ready. The race is about to start. Begin (start, commence, beginning).

k:旨.mnemonic: A spoon (匕) dipped in the same pot every day (日): you keep coming back for another taste because it is so good. Delicious (relish, show a liking for, purport).
k:旨.hint: Spoon back in the pot daily.

k:指.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) dipped in something delicious (旨): you lick them clean one at a time, then point at the pot for more. Finger (point to, indicate, put into).

k:典.mnemonic: Old scrolls that bend (曲) with age rest on one (一) table whose legs splay like fins (ハ): the books of law, kept on their own stand. Code (ceremony, law, classic).

k:吉.mnemonic: A samurai (士) stands on top of a mouth (口), the entrance to your home, and guards it. With him at the door only fortunate things come in. Good luck (joy, congratulations).

k:結.mnemonic: A paper slip promising good luck (吉) is knotted to a branch with thread (糸), fastened tight so that the fortune stays. Tie (bind, join, conclude).
k:結.hint: Fortune slip knotted to a branch.

k:四.mnemonic: Legs (儿) inside a fence (囗): the pen has one side for each leg of the animal kept in it. Count the sides. Four.
k:四.hint: A pen with a side per leg.

k:無.mnemonic: A stacked grid of timbers with flames licking underneath. When the fire has finished there is not a thing left. Nothing (none, without, -less).
k:無.hint: A bonfire burning it all away.

k:計.mnemonic: Say (言) the numbers aloud up to ten (十), again and again, as you pace out the length of a field. Measure (plan, total, plot).

k:切.mnemonic: A sword (刀) brought down on a spoon (匕): so sharp that the spoon falls in two neat pieces. Cut (cutoff, be sharp).

k:務.mnemonic: Take up your spear (矛) and strike (攵) with all your power (力): for the guard at the gate this is not a choice, it is the job. Duty (task, duties, job).

k:球.mnemonic: The master (主) tosses something into the water (水) for his dog, and it bobs there on the surface, round and floating. Ball (sphere).
k:球.hint: Something round bobbing in a pond.

k:役.mnemonic: A stroll (彳) with a weapon (殳) in hand: the sentry walking his rounds, playing the part he has been given. Role (duty, service, office).
